conditional_decisions.reason: Shared address-record candidate deliberately not admitted: eight fields combine record identity and postal address. Optional SRC-A id versus required SRC-B id and hash/diagnostic variants need a separate consumer selection; not needed by any frozen foundation.
Language identity and translation values pass all five questions without Locale/UI or business dependencies; freeze all class members, including constants.
Shared audit candidates excluded: actor/record/version/deletion lifecycle, nullable DateTime SRC-A versus string/default SRC-B contracts. No core dependency needs them.

Vector exposes Flutter Offset conversion; graph/point closure reaches vector. Retaining the complete API requires Flutter; removing those methods would redesign the selected boundary. Axis spec alone remains OUT_OF_SCOPE.

Generic attributes require separate admission of value decoding helpers; user values carry profile/JWT/session semantics, not a basic opaque identity primitive. No additional identity symbol admitted.
Amounts, movement totals, latest movement, inclusive date filters and ledgers require financial semantics. Valid exclusion, no implementation debt in issue #10.

amendments.reason: Correct baseline hash decoding to explicit UTF-8 (the Windows default decoded Utils Unicode as legacy text). Released file bytes and selected API/signatures/dependencies are unchanged. Original freeze commit be23eb7 predates implementation.
